blocks.title: Software process models
blocks.text: Software process models software development lifecycle ke amal ki mujarrad (abstract) numaindagi hain. Yeh software nizam banane ki planning, tarteeb aur control ke liye dhancha dete hain.

items: Predictability (pehle se andaza): tay shuda amal par chal kar teams nataij ka andaza aur khatron ka behtar intezam kar sakti hain.
Efficiency: munazzam tareeqe development ko hamwar karte aur zaya mehnat kam karte hain.
Quality: process model par chalne se quality assurance poore lifecycle mein shamil ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Software process model par chalne ke teen fawaid bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Predictability (nataij ka andaza aur khatron ka intezam), efficiency (kam zaya mehnat) aur quality (quality assurance shuru se aakhir tak shamil).

items: Process models: development ke amal ki mujarrad numaindagi; planning, tarteeb aur control ka dhancha.
